facts.fact: INSTAT, Mali's statistics institute, runs a data catalogue on its own domain (microdata.instat.ml) listing 107 studies, including the 2022 census (RGPH5) and agricultural surveys, as captured on 10 August 2026 (the capture date; the page has no date of its own).
